at_most_once.label: At most once
at_most_once.tooltip: This service level doesn’t guarantee the delivery of the payload. The client fires and forgets.

at_least_once.label: At least once
at_least_once.tooltip: Guarantees that the payload gets delivered at least once by sending it multiple times until the client gets an acknowledgment (PUBACK) of delivery.

exactly_once.label: Exactly once
exactly_once.tooltip: Guarantees that the payload gets delivered exactly once with a four-part handshake.

tooltips.message_properties: Pass metadata for each message sent.
tooltips.retain_message_long: Retaining messages allows a published message to be stored on the broker and delivered to new subscribers when they connect to the topic. This is useful for providing current state information or configuration updates to clients that were not subscribed when the message was originally published.
tooltips.retain_mesage_short: Retaining messages allows a published message to be stored on the broker and delivered to new subscribers when they connect to the topic.

receive_if_unique.label: Receive if unique subscription
receive_if_unique.tooltip: Broker sends the retained messages only if the topic isn’t already subscribed to.

settings.clean_session_description: Configure if the broker should start with a fresh connection without retaining any previous session data.
settings.clean_session_summary: Broker starts with a fresh connection without retaining any previous session data.
settings.session_expiry_interval_description: Configure the session expiry interval in seconds. This impacts how long a broker will store the session data for your client. If clean start is on, this value is ignored.
settings.session_expiry_interval_summary: Session expiry interval in seconds. This impacts how long a broker will store the session data for your client. If clean start is on, this value is ignored.
settings.keep_alive_description: Configure the keep alive interval in seconds.
settings.auto_reconnect_description: Configure if the client should automatically reconnect on abrupt disconnection.
settings.auto_reconnect_summary: Client automatically reconnects on abrupt disconnection.
settings.connection_timeout_description: Configure the connection timeout in seconds.
settings.receive_maximum_description: Configure the maximum number of QoS 1 and 2 messages that can be processed concurrently.
settings.receive_maximum_summary: Maximum number of QoS 1 and 2 messages that can be processed concurrently.
settings.maximum_packet_size_description: Configure the maximum packet size in bytes that the client will accept.
settings.maximum_packet_size_summary: Maximum packet size in bytes that the client will accept.
